svg.aria-label: A glowing circuit-board 5G tower at the centre, with its traces running out to six tiles. Own it: racks of servers on your own infrastructure. Trust nothing: every call authenticated. Spec in, core out: a 472-file spec becomes 26 network functions with a human gate. Sell anything: a new tariff is data, not code. See it coming: the AI predicts load and flags anomalies. What is next: Release 19 now, with Release 20 and 6G as a direction. Title: sovereign AI-powered 5G plus stack, on the path to 6G, for affordable markets and continuous research. Core, charging, BSS, integration. Motto as four icons: AI-built, sovereign by design, spec-bound, human-governed. An AI hexagon on the tower feeds three layers: AI Core, AI Charging, AI BSS.
